source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left, pixels; time = frame/24

camera.background: uniform white, no features; no pan/shake measurable (nothing static to reference) - assumed fixed as in all simulation clips
camera.view: oblique from above (boat deck and person's head/shoulders visible), treated as 2D plane per inputs.json

boat.description: red-and-white fishing boat (red hull, white deck, red cabin roof, mast), lower part of frame, bow pointing left-up
boat.reference_point: use tm_cx,tm_cy (bbox centre of the frame-0 mask + template-matched translation; robust to left-edge truncation from frame 63). cx,cy = mask centroid (biased after frame 63). bbox centre includes mast; hull centre/origin may differ by a constant offset, which does not affect displacements/speeds

motion_summary_px.direction: left and slightly up (~(-5.6,-1.6) px/frame), roughly constant

boat.edge_truncation: touches left image edge from frame 63 onward (bow leaving frame); bbox/centroid/extents unreliable there; still fully rigid so tm_* valid

person.description: single walking human (white shirt, dark trousers), small, upper-left-centre at x~360, walking down the image (toward camera/bottom)
person.reference_point: cx,cy = mask centroid (~waist/pelvis; pelvis is roughly at y0+0.5..0.55*bbox_h)

motion_summary_px.direction: down (+y), slight drift right; step size oscillates 0.6-2.7 px/frame with gait

person.note: image height oscillates with gait (legs swing); feet/head foreshortened by oblique view

events.event: frame 0 and frame 1 nearly identical: both objects start moving at frame 1 (t=0.042 s)
boat bow reaches left image edge (mask truncated from here)

no_contact: boat and person never touch or overlap
